explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/473: Segal's finite version, a permutation of {1,…,n} for every n ≥ 2 with consecutive sums prime. The statement uses a : Fin n ≃ Fin n, shifting values by +1 to get {1,…,n}, and requires (a k + 1) + (a (k+1) + 1) prime for all k with k+1 < n. Faithful.
